figurative_meaning_bn: ঘৃণা লজ্জা বিরক্তি অবিশ্বাস অসম্মতি প্রভৃতি ভাবপ্রকাশক
figurative_meaning_en: An expression conveying feelings of disgust, shame, annoyance, disbelief, disagreement, and similar emotions
example_sentences_in_bangla: দূর ছাই, এমন কাজ আমি করব না।
example_sentences_in_english: Fie, I won't do such a thing.
Away with it, this proposal is absolutely impossible.
note: The idiom mimics the act of blowing away ash to express strong rejection, common in everyday Bengali speech.
